title: The frontend asks for a tattoo on every cow; DR1 asks a cow only for an ear tag and a passport.

finding.frontend: The cow identification record offers three fields in this order — Passport number, Tattoo, Ear tag number. Tattoo is there because Cow is on the tattoo allowlist alongside Cat and Dog (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/services/commodities/stub.js:109), which gates the tattoo obligation at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/commodities/identifiers.js:127-135.
finding.prototype: DR1's cattle panel offers two fields, Ear tag then Passport. Tattoo is not on the cattle set at all — app/data/commodity-identifiers.js:9-12 gives commodity code 0102 exactly Ear tag and Passport, and Tattoo appears only under 01061900, the cat/dog/ferret code.
finding.difference: Remove Cow from the tattoo allowlist in the commodities stub so the tattoo obligation stops applying to cattle lines. Nothing else moves: tattoo stays in scope for cats and dogs, and the at-least-one-identifier rule on the unit record is still satisfiable for a cow through the ear tag or the passport. Any saved cow record already holding a tattoo value is orphaned by the change, so check whether stored answers need clearing when the obligation goes out of scope.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a Tattoo field on DR1's cattle identification panel, or a cattle entry in app/data/commodity-identifiers.js that carries a tattoo identifier.
finding.correction: Sound, and the only finding in this slice where both sides are photographed rather than read: the frontend screenshot shows Passport number, Tattoo and Ear tag number on the cow panel, and the DR1 screenshot shows Ear tag and Passport on the cattle panel and nothing else. The rule behind each was traced as well as the picture. Frontend: TATTOO_COMMODITIES is ['Cat', 'Dog', 'Cow'], and the tattoo obligation is gated on it by allowListed at obligations/sections/commodities/identifiers.js:127-135. DR1: getIdentifierFieldsForSpecies (app/routes.js:1458-1471) resolves cattle through commodity code 0102, which app/data/commodity-identifiers.js:9-12 gives exactly ear-tag and passport; the commodity's own identifiers array is built from the same call, so there is no second path that could reintroduce a tattoo. One consequence the finding does not follow through: with tattoo gone the frontend renders Passport then Ear tag where DR1 renders Ear tag then Passport, because the frontend orders identifiers globally and DR1 orders them per commodity. That is now identification--identifier-field-order.

relatedTo.why: the same per-commodity identifier sets; both are corrections to which identifier types a commodity is asked for
